notes: License verified earlier as GPL-2.0 open source; could not verify official download URL in this pass. URL: Official project site; stable installers are linked from its Downloads section.

windows11.notes: Covers only the linked portable package, not other installers.

name: WinMTR
description: Visual Windows port of MTR combining ping and traceroute in one tool, released under the GPLv2. Barely maintained but still functional.

name: WinObj
description: Freeware Sysinternals viewer for the NT Object Manager namespace, showing devices, drivers, symbolic links and other kernel objects. It is the definitive tool for exploring the object directory.

name: WinPenguins
description: Desktop toy that sends cute penguins wandering across windows, the taskbar and the screen edge. Pop them with the cursor or steer the skateboarders with arrow keys.
notes: GPL confirmed on the ricky65/WinPenguins GitHub repo and SoftLookup. Active: v1.2 supports Windows 10/11 and is on the Microsoft Store. Basket Utilities/Gadgets kept.

name: WinSCP
description: SFTP, FTP, SCP and WebDAV client for Windows, released under the GPL.

name: WinWGet
description: Windows GUI front end for the GNU Wget downloader, released under the GPLv2.
notes: could not verify the developer's download page; the WinWGet+ fork is closed-source freeware and is a different project. URL: Project's official homepage on SourceForge web space; the standalone cybershade.us/winwget site it linked is no longer reachable.

name: WireGuard
description: Official Windows client for the WireGuard VPN protocol. The client is free and open source; you supply the VPN server configuration.

name: Wise Disk Cleaner
description: Freeware junk-file cleaner by WiseCleaner that removes temporary files, browser traces and other clutter to free disk space. The official site states the free edition is completely free with lifetime updates.

name: Wise Duplicate Finder
description: Wise Duplicate Finder finds and removes duplicate files on a drive. It is freeware.
free_enough_reason: The free version fully searches for and deletes duplicate files; only the automatic 'Keep One' option requires the Pro version.

name: Wise Force Deleter
description: Wise Force Deleter deletes files locked by other processes. It is completely free with no paid tier.

name: Wise JetSearch
description: Wise JetSearch is a file search tool from WiseCleaner. It is freeware.

name: Wise Program Uninstaller
description: Freeware uninstaller by WiseCleaner that removes desktop programs, Windows apps and browser extensions, with force uninstall for broken entries.
free_enough_reason: The free edition is a complete uninstaller with leftover cleanup, force uninstall and no ads, per TechRadar and Gizmodo reviews.
notes: UNCERTAIN: third-party pages (an IObit comparison, coupon listings) reference a newer paid Pro tier (~$9.97/yr) adding deeper leftover scanning and support; could not verify its feature split on the official site.

name: Wise Registry Cleaner
description: Freeware registry cleaner by WiseCleaner that scans for invalid entries, backs up changes before cleaning and defragments the registry.
free_enough_reason: The free edition is a complete registry cleaner; Pro adds multi-user scanning and priority support.
notes: UNCERTAIN: the product page URL could not be captured verbatim, so the official homepage is used above. Could not verify whether the free edition shows Pro upgrade prompts.

name: WizFile
description: WizFile is a disk search utility from Antibody Software. It is freeware; personal use is free while commercial use requires a Supporter or Enterprise license.

name: WizTree
description: WizTree is a disk space analyzer that scans drives quickly. It is freeware, free for personal use only; commercial use requires a paid license.

name: Wizznic
description: Match-3 style puzzle game.
notes: License GPL-3.0 (open source). UNCERTAIN: could not verify an official URL. URL: Developer homepage is dead; PortableApps.com publishes the maintained Wizznic Portable build and this release page links its app homepage.

name: Workrave
description: Reminds you to take micro-breaks and rest breaks to prevent RSI, with usage statistics.
notes: GPL-3.0-or-later; 1.11.4 released Sep 2026. Basket Lifestyle/Health is correct.

name: wxMP3gain
description: Graphical front-end for MP3Gain to normalize track volume without re-encoding.
notes: GPL; 4.2 released May 2024.

windows11.notes: The project says it tested its precompiled binaries on Windows 11. We haven't tested them here.

name: X-Moto
description: Challenging 2D motocross platformer where physics matter. Collect strawberries and touch the flower to finish; thousands of user-made levels.
notes: License GPL-2.0-or-later (open source). official_url from the Arch AUR upstream field, not the verbatim Full URLs list; UNCERTAIN: Wikipedia lists xmoto.org as the website instead.

name: XAMPP
description: One-installer package of Apache, MariaDB/MySQL, PHP and Perl for local web development. Includes phpMyAdmin and a control panel to start and stop services.
notes: Apache Friends releases the XAMPP compilation under the GPL; bundled components carry their own licenses. Completely free, no paid tiers and no upsell in the product. Basket confirmed.

name: XMPlay
description: Tiny, skinnable audio player famous for low resource use and module-format support.
notes: Freeware; no ads or nags.

name: XN Resource Editor
description: A resource editor and PE module explorer with special support for Delphi programs.
notes: MPL/GPL open source. The original developer site is gone; stefansundin.github.io hosts a mirror of the last build (3.0.0.1) and source is mirrored on GitHub.

name: XnConvert
description: Batch image converter and resizer with over 80 actions and live preview.
notes: Free for personal and non-commercial use; commercial users need a license.

name: XnView MP
description: Modern cross-platform image browser with tabbed interface, rating and cataloging.
notes: Free for personal and non-commercial use; commercial users need a license.

name: XnView
description: Image browser and viewer supporting 500+ formats with batch rename and conversion.
notes: Free for personal and non-commercial use; commercial users need a license.

name: Xonotic
description: Fast multiplayer arena first-person shooter with a large weapon set.
notes: License GPLv3+ (open source). official_url from page text, not the verbatim Full URLs list.

name: Xye
description: Tile puzzle game where you guide a green sprite through levels using keys and objects.
notes: License zlib/libpng (open source). UNCERTAIN: could not verify an official URL. URL: Developer's official download page on the project's own homepage; serves the portable Windows zip.

name: Yubico Authenticator
description: Desktop app that generates one-time passcodes from a YubiKey hardware key. Open source; requires a YubiKey.
notes: requires a YubiKey hardware key; could not verify the exact OSI license from search results.

name: YUMI exFAT
description: Open source multiboot USB creator (GPL) for exFAT-formatted drives that boots multiple operating systems from one USB stick. Latest release v1.0.2.4 (Oct 2023).

windows11.notes: Evidence comes from the host requirements section listing Windows 11/10/8, not from mentions of creating Windows 11 installation media.

name: YUMI Legacy
description: Open source multiboot USB creator (GPL-2.0) that installs multiple Linux distributions and tools on one drive. Archived at v2.0.9.4 (Jan 2022); the publisher recommends the exFAT variant for current use.
review_notes: Archived edition. Use the maintained YUMI exFAT listing.

name: YUMI UEFI
description: Open source multiboot USB creator (GPL-2.0) with UEFI support. It remains an archived preview at v0.0.4.5 (Mar 2022).
review_notes: Archived edition. Use the maintained YUMI exFAT listing.

name: Zaz
description: Zuma-style marble puzzle; remove incoming marbles by arranging same-color triplets or quartets. 23 levels.
notes: License GPLv3 (open source) per Wikipedia. official_url from page text, not the verbatim Full URLs list. URL: Developer's official site, listed as the homepage by Wikipedia and Debian.

windows11.notes: Covers only the linked portable package, not other installers.

name: Zettlr
description: Open-source (GPL-3.0) Markdown editor for researchers and note-takers with citation support, Zettelkasten knowledge management and exports via Pandoc and LaTeX.
notes: Donations requested on the site; all features work without donating.

name: Zim
description: Desktop personal wiki (GPL-2.0-or-later) keeping notes as plain-text wiki pages in a folder structure, with linking, plugins, task list and equation editor. Actively released (0.77.0, June 2026).
notes: URL scheme (https) assumed for zim-wiki.org; could not verify canonical scheme. Windows builds support 64-bit Windows 10 only.

windows11.notes: The publisher says its installer was built and tested on 64-bit Windows 11. We haven't tested it here.

name: Zint Barcode Studio
description: A GUI for generating barcodes and QR codes in over 50 symbologies and exporting them as image files.
notes: Dual-licensed: the encoding library is BSD-3-clause and the GUI/CLI are GPL-3.0-or-later.

name: Zoom
description: Video conferencing app for meetings, webinars and chat. Free Basic plan supports up to 100 participants.
free_enough_reason: Basic is a permanent free plan with unlimited meetings for up to 100 participants; the 40-minute per-meeting cap is a standing product limit, not a trial.
notes: Free tier clears the bar: Zoom Workplace Basic is permanent, not a trial, with unlimited meetings. The 40-minute limit on every meeting (including 1-on-1s since 2022) is a product limitation, and the meeting can be restarted for free. Judgment: free_enough=true, with the cap disclosed so users know the boundary. Requires a free Zoom account to host; could not verify whether guests can join without an account. Official URL not verified verbatim; zoom.us used.

name: ZoomIt
description: A Microsoft Sysinternals tool for zooming the screen and annotating during presentations. It is also bundled with PowerToys.
notes: Microsoft freeware with no nags, ads or paywalls. Could not verify official download URL in this pass. URL: Official Microsoft Sysinternals page by Mark Russinovich with the direct zip download and Sysinternals Live run link.

name: Zotero
description: Research manager that collects, organizes and cites sources with browser capture.
notes: AGPL-3.0. An account is only needed for sync (300 MB free storage); core features work offline. Paid storage tiers are an optional service, not an app tier. Basket Lifestyle/Education kept.

name: Zulip
description: Threaded team chat client for workplaces and communities.
notes: License Apache-2.0 (open source). Core use requires a Zulip organization account. official_url from page text, not the verbatim Full URLs list.
